introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Further Mathematics 3 (0775), ADVANCED LEVEL, June 2025. Duration: Two and a Half Hours.**

Answer ALL questions. For your guidance the approximate mark allocation for parts of each question is indicated in brackets. Mathematical formulae and tables, published by the Board, and noiseless non-programmable electronic calculators are allowed. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage.
enonce_intro_markdown: The force $\mathbf{F} = (4\mathbf{i} - 7\mathbf{j} - 4\mathbf{k})\ \mathrm{N}$ acts at the point with position vector $(3\mathbf{i} + 4\mathbf{j} - 6\mathbf{k})\ \mathrm{m}$.

questions.enonce_markdown: Write down a vector equation of the line of action of $\mathbf{F}$. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The line of action of $\mathbf{F}$ passes through the point of application, with position vector $\mathbf{r}_0 = 3\mathbf{i}+4\mathbf{j}-6\mathbf{k}$, and is parallel to $\mathbf{F}$. Hence

$$\mathbf{r} = (3\mathbf{i}+4\mathbf{j}-6\mathbf{k}) + \lambda\,(4\mathbf{i}-7\mathbf{j}-4\mathbf{k}),\qquad \lambda\in\mathbb{R}.$$

questions.enonce_markdown: Find the work done when a particle moves under the influence of $\mathbf{F}$ from the point $A(2,3,4)$ to the point $B(6,-1,10)$. *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The force is constant, so the work done is $W = \mathbf{F}\cdot\overrightarrow{AB}$.

$$\overrightarrow{AB} = (6-2)\mathbf{i} + (-1-3)\mathbf{j} + (10-4)\mathbf{k} = 4\mathbf{i}-4\mathbf{j}+6\mathbf{k}\ \ \mathrm{m}$$

$$W = (4\mathbf{i}-7\mathbf{j}-4\mathbf{k})\cdot(4\mathbf{i}-4\mathbf{j}+6\mathbf{k}) = 4(4)+(-7)(-4)+(-4)(6) = 16+28-24 = 20$$

The work done is $20\ \mathrm{J}$.

questions.enonce_markdown: Find the vector moment of $\mathbf{F}$ about the origin. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The moment about the origin of a force acting at the point with position vector $\mathbf{r}$ is $\mathbf{M}_O = \mathbf{r}\times\mathbf{F}$.

$$\mathbf{M}_O = \begin{vmatrix}\mathbf{i}&\mathbf{j}&\mathbf{k}\\ 3&4&-6\\ 4&-7&-4\end{vmatrix}
= \mathbf{i}\big[4(-4)-(-6)(-7)\big]-\mathbf{j}\big[3(-4)-(-6)(4)\big]+\mathbf{k}\big[3(-7)-4(4)\big]$$

$$\mathbf{M}_O = \mathbf{i}(-16-42)-\mathbf{j}(-12+24)+\mathbf{k}(-21-16) = -58\mathbf{i}-12\mathbf{j}-37\mathbf{k}\ \ \mathrm{N\,m}$$

questions.enonce_markdown: Find the vector moment of $\mathbf{F}$ about the point with position vector $(\mathbf{i} + 2\mathbf{j} - 3\mathbf{k})\ \mathrm{m}$. *[4 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Let $P$ be the point with position vector $\mathbf{p} = \mathbf{i}+2\mathbf{j}-3\mathbf{k}$. The moment about $P$ is $\mathbf{M}_P = (\mathbf{r}-\mathbf{p})\times\mathbf{F}$, where $\mathbf{r}$ is the point of application.

$$\mathbf{r}-\mathbf{p} = (3-1)\mathbf{i}+(4-2)\mathbf{j}+(-6+3)\mathbf{k} = 2\mathbf{i}+2\mathbf{j}-3\mathbf{k}$$

$$\mathbf{M}_P = \begin{vmatrix}\mathbf{i}&\mathbf{j}&\mathbf{k}\\ 2&2&-3\\ 4&-7&-4\end{vmatrix}
= \mathbf{i}\big[2(-4)-(-3)(-7)\big]-\mathbf{j}\big[2(-4)-(-3)(4)\big]+\mathbf{k}\big[2(-7)-2(4)\big]$$

$$\mathbf{M}_P = \mathbf{i}(-8-21)-\mathbf{j}(-8+12)+\mathbf{k}(-14-8) = -29\mathbf{i}-4\mathbf{j}-22\mathbf{k}\ \ \mathrm{N\,m}$$

Check: $\mathbf{M}_P = \mathbf{M}_O - \mathbf{p}\times\mathbf{F}$ with $\mathbf{p}\times\mathbf{F} = (1,2,-3)\times(4,-7,-4) = (-29,\,-8,\,-15)$, so $\mathbf{M}_P = (-58+29)\mathbf{i}+(-12+8)\mathbf{j}+(-37+15)\mathbf{k} = -29\mathbf{i}-4\mathbf{j}-22\mathbf{k}$, as found.

questions.enonce_markdown: Find the distance from the origin to the line of action of $\mathbf{F}$. *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
If $d$ is the perpendicular distance from the origin to the line of action, the magnitude of the moment about the origin equals force times perpendicular distance: $|\mathbf{M}_O| = |\mathbf{F}|\,d$.

$$|\mathbf{M}_O| = \sqrt{(-58)^2+(-12)^2+(-37)^2} = \sqrt{3364+144+1369} = \sqrt{4877}$$

$$|\mathbf{F}| = \sqrt{4^2+(-7)^2+(-4)^2} = \sqrt{16+49+16} = \sqrt{81} = 9\ \mathrm{N}$$

$$d = \frac{|\mathbf{M}_O|}{|\mathbf{F}|} = \frac{\sqrt{4877}}{9} \approx 7.76\ \mathrm{m}\ \ (3\ \text{s.f.})$$
